identity: A secondary-school / first-year biology multiple-choice bank: 20 questions on DNA repair, osmosis in root cells, prokaryotes, mitosis, cyclins and CDK, plant reproduction, translation, apoptosis, plant transport and defence, positive feedback, spermatogenesis, GMO, muscles, ADH and fertilisation. Exactly ONE question per printed line, each with a stem and FOUR options; the typing is unvocalised and sloppy (للاوعيه الدمويه، التلت، ماسبق، اختراقة).
law: MCQ BANK (section I), the same law that scored 100.0 on doc_a17df83313f0 and is applied unchanged here. Median line 21 tokens, but a line is a QUESTION, not a paragraph: I2 the stem is ONE unit up to where the four siblings begin, I3 each of the four options is its own unit however long or short, 0h the stem keeps its internal connectives. 456 real tokens / 100 units = 4.6 per unit, larger than the 2.4 of the primary-school sheets only because the options here are technical phrases.
reasoning: Every line resolved into stem + exactly four siblings, and that count is the strongest check available - four is the constant, so any stem boundary that leaves three or five options is wrong. Six lines end the stem on a dangling function word, the I2 colon-in-disguise: @43 bi-sabab, @212 an tariq, @303 bi (single letter), @345 bi (single letter), @412 indama, @268 al-ghudda (dangling idafa head, like min sifat in doc_a17df83313f0). 0h earned its keep at @123: the stem ayy al-brutinat al-atiya tartabit bi cdk WA-TUSNA WA-TUHATTAM athna dawrat al-khaliyya contains two internal w-conjuncts and they do NOT cut - a stem is one unit however many connectives it holds; had I fired 1j inside it I would have produced six options instead of four. The same guard applies at @389-@400 (wa-la tanqasim marratan ukhra rides inside the stem) and at @346-@353 where fa-yughliq al-juz al-mumazzaq rides inside ONE option. Two lines have very short stems and long options - @371 al-dieama al-fisiyulujiyya (2 tokens) and @432 huduth al-ikhsab (2 tokens) - and I resisted the urge to pull more material into the stem, because the four following spans are plainly the four choices, ending in the giveaway awwal ijabatayn. Meta-answer options are single units and are never split: jami al-ijabat al-sabiqa sahiha, kull ma sabaq, jami ma sabaq, jami ma sabaq, akhir ijabatayn, awwal ijabatayn, la tujad ijaba. Bare-letter and Latin tokens are options in their own right on line 7 (tRNA / mRNA / al-raybusum / DNA), which is I3 at its most extreme.
